如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    一看到这种异象，杨云帆忍不住激动万分。
下一刻，这金色大字只是一闪而过，随即，化为一团金光，直冲杨云帆的嘴巴。
咕噜一下，未等杨云帆反应，这金光就被他吞金了肚子里。
一瞬间，医道问卜，修行法诀，无数的记忆，纷纷涌进了杨云帆的脑袋之中。这记忆量实在是太过于庞大，杨云帆只觉得自己的大脑就要炸开了。
他赶紧到火车站旁边找了一个破旅馆，然后砰的一声关上了门。
朝阳初升，紫气东来。
杨云帆的身体在床上无形间摆出了一个五气朝元的姿势。
随着脑海里《鸿蒙紫气诀》第一层法诀，“引气境”的修炼方法。杨云帆就这样在房间里开始引导外界的天地元力，进入自己的身体。
所谓“引气入体，淬炼己身”是修炼的第一步。
若是身体不够强健，无法承受强大的灵气，就如空中楼阁，再强大的法诀也只是昙花一现，不能持久。
杨云帆的修炼并不是自己刻意进行的，而是在不经意间，本能的开始的，近乎可遇不可求的“天人合一”，修行速度也是无与伦比。
随着他功法的运转，他身体所在地方的四周很快形成了一道元力漩涡，犹如长鲸吸水一般，无穷的天地元气从四面八方山川沼泽内汇聚过来，聚拢在他身边，形成了一团紫色雾气，好不神奇。
而他身体的变化尤为明显，原本黝黑的皮肤，现在竟然在这紫气氤氲的温养之下，渐渐的变得荧光月白，面目也变得俊朗起来，眉宇之间，更是隐隐透露出一股子神秘高贵的气息。
“呼……好舒坦啊。”
身体随着《鸿蒙紫气诀》运转，一夜到天亮，杨云帆浑身舒坦不已，好似在温泉里面泡了个热水澡一样。
此时，阳光有些刺眼，他微微眯起了眼睛，打量四周。
他看到在窗台上，有一株快要枯萎的含羞草。
杨云帆走过去，不由伸出双手扶摸上去。他的手上带着一丝紫色的灵力，昨晚他初步修炼《鸿蒙紫气诀》，一晚上竟然就修炼成功了，让他进入了引气境第一层。
一些灵气的妙用，他已经在心中有数。此时，只不过是想试验一下。
随着他的抚摸，紫色灵力不时闪烁。渐渐的，那株即将枯萎的含羞草，爆发出了惊人的生命力，枯萎的黄色很快变得翠绿昂扬，干枯的枝叶更是变得苍翠欲滴，充满生机。

“原来这一丝紫气，竟然对这株植物有这么好的治疗效果。不知道，能不能用在人身上？”看着那株快死的含羞草又变得生机勃勃，杨云帆满意的收回自己的灵力。想等什么时候有机会，找个人来试试这灵力的效果。
“对了，老头子让我去星海国际找人，应该是今天吧？”
杨云帆想到这里，就收拾好了东西，退房离开，前往星海国际大厦。
等杨云帆走后，旅馆进来打扫的人，记得窗口有一株快死的含羞草，正准备收拾掉，可是那人开窗一看，诡异的发现，这株要死的含羞草，竟然活了，一时间，有些难以相信。
星海国际大厦。
这座大厦是湘潭市最高的建筑，也是湘潭市最大的公司，星海国际的总部所在。
33楼，总裁办公室。
哒哒哒！
一大早上，总裁办公室的门外，就响起了一串焦急的高跟鞋声音。
楼道中，一个身材高挑，长发高高盘起，容貌艳丽，却始终带着一丝寒霜的女子，正快步走来。这个人正是星海国际集团的高级总监，顾若秋。
“顾总监，早上好。”
看到来人，前台值班的工作人员，忙站起来问好，然后道：“顾总监，总裁说如果你来了，可以直接进去，她正在里面等你。”
“知道了！”顾若秋高傲的点点头，惜字如金。
顾若秋挥手让其他人离自己远点，而后进入总裁办公室，接着砰的一下，就把门关的严严实实。
她一走进门去，就把自己的高跟鞋扔到一边，然后从鞋柜里拿出自己的拖鞋。
看着面前这个容貌美丽，让她都不由自惭形秽，宛如神仙中人一样的总裁叶轻雪，她忍不住叹了一口气：“轻雪，你还真是沉得住气。我早上得到消息的时候，真是快急死了！”
“若秋姐，你有什么好急的啊？又不是你的未婚夫来湘潭市了。”正在检查集团上月财报的叶轻雪，微微一笑。她这一笑，让整个房间都变得明亮起来。

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author’s copyright complaint fast track. Upon seeing this strange phenomenon, Yang Yunfan couldn’t help but be extremely excited.
The next moment, the golden characters just flashed by, and then turned into a ball of golden light, heading straight towards Yang Yunfan's mouth.
After a grunt, Yang Yunfan swallowed the golden light into his stomach before he could react.
In an instant, countless memories of medical questions, divination, and rituals poured into Yang Yunfan's head. The amount of memory was so huge that Yang Yunfan felt like his brain was going to explode.
He hurried to a shabby hotel next to the train station and slammed the door.
The morning sun rises, and the purple air comes from the east.
Yang Yunfan's body was invisibly placed on the bed in a posture with five qi in full swing.
With the first level of the "Hongmeng Purple Qi Jue" in my mind, the practice method of "Qi Entrainment Realm". In this way, Yang Yunfan began to guide the energy of heaven and earth from the outside world into his body in the room.
The so-called "introducing Qi into the body and tempering the body" is the first step in cultivation.
If the body is not strong enough to withstand the powerful spiritual energy, it will be like a castle in the air. No matter how powerful the magic formula is, it will only be short-lived and cannot last.
Yang Yunfan's cultivation was not carried out deliberately by himself, but started inadvertently and instinctively. The "unity of man and nature" is almost something that can only be encountered and cannot be obtained. The speed of cultivation is also unparalleled.
With the operation of his technique, a vortex of energy quickly formed around the place where his body was, just like a whale sucking water. The infinite energy of heaven and earth gathered from the mountains, rivers and swamps in all directions and gathered around him, forming a purple mist. It was so magical.
The changes in his body were particularly obvious. His originally dark skin now gradually turned fluorescent moon-white under the warmth of the dense purple air, and his face became more handsome. There was a mysterious and noble aura between his eyebrows.
"Huh...it feels so comfortable."
His body moved along with the "Hongmeng Purple Qi Jue". From night to dawn, Yang Yunfan felt as comfortable as if he had taken a hot bath in a hot spring.
At this time, the sun was a little dazzling, so he squinted his eyes slightly and looked around.
He saw a mimosa plant that was about to wither on the windowsill.
Yang Yunfan walked over and couldn't help but stretched out his hands to touch it. There was a trace of purple spiritual power on his hand. Last night he initially practiced the "Hongmeng Purple Qi Jue", and he succeeded in practicing it in one night, allowing him to enter the first level of the Qi Entrainment Realm.
He already knew some of the wonderful uses of spiritual energy. At this time, I just wanted to experiment.
With his touch, purple spiritual power flickered from time to time. Gradually, the mimosa plant that was about to wither burst out with amazing vitality. The withered yellow color soon became emerald green and high-spirited, and the dry branches and leaves became green and full of life.
"It turns out that this trace of purple energy has such a good therapeutic effect on this plant. I wonder if it can be used on people?" Seeing that the dying mimosa became full of life again, Yang Yunfan took back his spiritual power with satisfaction. I want to wait for the opportunity to find someone to try the effect of this spiritual power.
"By the way, the old man asked me to go to Xinghai International to find someone. It should be today, right?"
Thinking of this, Yang Yunfan packed up his things, checked out and left, heading to Xinghai International Building.
After Yang Yunfan left, the hotel cleaner came in and remembered that there was a dying mimosa in the window and was about to clean it up. However, when the man opened the window and took a look, he strangely found that the dying mimosa was actually alive. For a moment, it was hard to believe it.
Xinghai International Building.
This building is the tallest building in Xiangtan City and the headquarters of Xinghai International, the largest company in Xiangtan City.
On the 33rd floor, the president's office.
Ta-ta-ta!
Early in the morning, a series of anxious high-heeled shoes sounded outside the door of the president's office.In the corridor, a tall woman with long hair tied up high and a beautiful face, but always with a hint of frost, was walking quickly. This person is none other than Gu Ruoqiu, the senior director of Xinghai International Group.
"Director Gu, good morning."
Seeing the person coming, the staff member on duty at the front desk quickly stood up and said hello, and then said: "Director Gu, the president said that if you come, you can go in directly. She is waiting for you inside."
"Got it!" Gu Ruoqiu nodded proudly, cherishing every word like gold.
Gu Ruoqiu waved others to stay away from her, then entered the president's office, then slammed the door tightly.
As soon as she walked in, she threw her high heels aside and took out her slippers from the shoe cabinet.
Looking at the CEO Ye Qingxue, whose face was so beautiful that she couldn't help but feel ashamed, and who looked like a fairy, she couldn't help but sigh: "Qingxue, you really can keep your composure. When I got the news in the morning, I was so anxious!"
"Sister Ruoqiu, what are you so anxious about? It's not your fiancé who has come to Xiangtan City." Ye Qingxue, who was checking the group's financial report for last month, smiled slightly. Her smile brightened the whole room.
